latestVersion.changelog:
Infinite Talk AI 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate looping talking avatar videos from your images or video, with no manual adjustments required.
- Upload MP4, MOV, JPG, or PNG files (up to 200MB), add voiceover instructions, and export 1080p MP4 videos.
- Automatic session management and free trial token generation (100 credits, 7-day validity) for new users.
- Cloud-based GPU rendering with quick export (30–90 seconds for most jobs).
- Simple, prompt-driven workflow built for content creators, marketers, and educators.
- Direct support for file uploads, timeline editing, credit checks, and export, with robust error handling.
